 Changi Airport and Lotte Duty Free showcase rare wines and spirits at WOWS 2026 
 By Sheena Adesilu 
 in Airports , Asia/Pacific , Latest News , Liquor & Wines , Retail News 
 October 29, 2026 0 
 The fifth edition of World of Wines & Spirits featured more than 60 releases from 30 brands, including rare expressions from The Macallan, The Dalmore and Fettercairn
 Changi Airport Group (CAG) and Lotte Duty Free Singapore have celebrated the fifth edition of World of Wines & Spirits (WOWS) with an exclusive showcase of rare and premium wines and spirits.
 Held at JW Marriott Singapore South Beach , the annual event, titled ‘ The Vault ’, welcomed 600 guests and featured more than 60 releases from more than 30 established labels, including The Macallan , The Dalmore and Fettercairn .
 The showcase highlighted the craftsmanship and heritage behind some of the world’s most sought-after wines and spirits through immersive tasting experiences, storytelling and curated food pairings.
 Among the highlights was The Dalmore Cask Curation Series: The Madeira Cask Edition (S$64,000), a collection of three whiskies of varying ages, alongside Fettercairn The Vanguard Series Rare – 30 Years Old (S$4,050).
 Other notable releases included The Macallan Red Collection Set (S$368,200), comprising three age-statement whiskies, and Tales of The Macallan Volume II (S$114,000), commemorating the distillery’s 200-year history.
 The event featured five experiential tasting zones dedicated to Japanese Whiskies , Cognacs , Single Malts , Wines & Champagnes , and Rare & Fine .
 The Japanese Whiskies zone showcased expressions including Hibiki 30 Years Old and Yamazaki 25 Years Old Mizunara , while the Cognacs zone featured L’Or de Jean Martell – Zodiac Edition: L’Assemblage du Chèvre and Hennessy Paradis Year of the Goat 2027 Edition .
 Also on display was the LOUIS XIII WOWS 2026 Edition , an exclusive limited edition featuring landmarks from Singapore and Changi .
 The Wines & Champagnes zone brought together premium vintages including Dom Pérignon P3 1993 , Château Margaux 2015 and Penfolds Block 42 Kalimna Cabernet Sauvignon 2004 , complemented by an artisanal cheese bar.
 Meanwhile, the Rare & Fine zone showcased some of the event’s most exclusive expressions, including The GlenDronach Aged 56 Years , Glenmorangie 50 Years Old and The Macallan Tales of Macallan Volume II .
 Guests were also treated to a selection of Kaluga Queen caviar canapés paired with fine spirits, including Fettercairn 17yo -infused smoked quail egg with Kaluga caviar and aged kingfish tartare with Kaluga Queen A&K caviar.
 WOWS 2026 also introduced a Grand Draw, offering qualifying customers the chance to win a four-day, three-night Kaluga Queen Caviar Experience in Hangzhou, China .
 The prize includes a behind-the-scenes tour of the caviar-making process, expert-led tastings and a Champagne-paired afternoon tea overlooking Qiandao Lake . One winner will be announced in November .
 As part of the event, customers spending S$5,000 with Mastercard , the official payment partner, will receive a complimentary set of two Christofle Old Fashioned Crystal Glasses worth S$540. The qualifying spend for other payment methods is S$7,000.
 The 2026 edition marks five years of collaboration between Changi Airport Group and Lotte Duty Free Singapore , reinforcing their commitment to developing Singapore ‘s position as a luxury travel retail destination.
 The WOWS 2026 collection remains available for discovery and purchase through the WOWS website , with product reservations also available through Changi Airport’s Shopping Concierge .
 Prices are duty-free and tax-free for eligible travellers, subject to applicable purchase and collection requirements.
